content_record.title: Ribonucleotide misincorporation into mtDNA triggers inflammation and senescence
content_record.editorial_body: Nucleotide imbalance drives age-related inflammation by destabilizing mitochondrial DNA, activating cGAS-STING and SASP. Three things to remember - Nucleotide imbalance increases ribonucleotide misincorporation into mtDNA. - This triggers mtDNA release, cGAS-STING activation, and SASP. - Adding deoxyribonucleosides suppresses the inflammatory response. Source This signal is based on Ribonucleotide incorporation into mitochondrial DNA drives inflammation. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context. Health note: Mouse and cell models; human relevance not yet established.
